【原视频简介】
Russian President Vladimir Putin gets behind the wheel of a new Chinese-designed Russian car during a visit to the Gorky Automotive Plant in Nizhny Novgorod, with footage showing Putin test-driving the vehicle at the manufacturing facility.

Putin visited the Gorky Automotive Plant in Nizhny Novgorod, where he inspected the automotive operation and took the new vehicle for a test drive.

The footage shows the Russian president behind the wheel as he tests the car inside the manufacturing plant. The visit highlights Russia’s domestic automotive industry and its growing links with Chinese automotive technology and design.

The vehicle is part of a broader shift in Russia’s automotive market, where Chinese automakers and technology have become increasingly important. Cooperation between Russian manufacturers and Chinese companies has expanded as the industry adapts to major changes in the market.

Putin’s factory visit also puts the spotlight on Russian car manufacturing, industrial production and Moscow’s efforts to maintain and develop its automotive sector.

The Gorky Automotive Plant, commonly known as GAZ, is one of Russia’s historic vehicle manufacturers and is based in Nizhny Novgorod.

DWS News brings you the latest footage from Putin’s visit, including the moment the Russian president takes the new car for a test drive.
